source.name: Liam Ottley
source.subject: $28k AI Contract Without Quitting His Job

raw_signal: AI agency education is selling the story that full-time employees can use Claude Code and limited spare time to close high-ticket AI implementation contracts.
buyer: Full-time workers, aspiring AI agency owners, consultants, non-technical operators, and people who want high-ticket AI service income.
pain: They believe they do not have enough time, technical skill, or confidence to sell AI implementation services.
why_now: Claude Code and similar tools compress build time, making AI implementation offers feel accessible to people with limited time.
first_product: A tool or report that generates niche-specific AI agency offers, scopes, pricing, outreach scripts, and 48-hour validation tasks.
price: $29 for an offer pack, $99 for a workshop, $299-$999 for a guided AI Product Opportunity Sprint.
distribution: X, Skool, YouTube shorts, AI agency communities, Japanese side-hustle audiences, LinkedIn.
lead_magnet_angle: 5 AI agency offers you can pitch this weekend.
content_angle: AI side income does not start with building a tool. It starts with a narrow paid implementation offer.
bilion_access_angle: Bilion helps users turn market signals into offers, build prompts, and outreach scripts instead of random AI tool ideas.
